templates.name: Recommended
templates.description: Set up the full 13-Grunt roster: Claude Code, Codex and Pi across Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter, each launched like the harness already is on this desktop (including its Skip approvals choice). Reuses matching Grunts and switches off the bare Claude Code, Codex and Pi defaults.
templates.compatibility_notes: Exact selected model IDs checked in official sources; account access and native responses are checked on application. Preserves unrelated custom Grunts and never switches off the System Grunt or a Grunt a Ritual or Minion launches. Requires native provider access, the shared OpenRouter key (or native Pi login) for Pi, and an existing OpenRouter reference for the two Claude Code OpenRouter Grunts; unknown effort combinations remain native.

templates.name: Latest
templates.description: Update existing pinned Grunts to newer generally available models in the same provider, family and tier. Keeps IDs and custom settings; adds or deletes nothing.
templates.compatibility_notes: Requires a ready System Grunt and access to the configured providers. Actual model access is checked before each change.

templates.name: Balanced
templates.description: Create or update two model-specific Codex Grunts: GPT-6 Luna for everyday work and GPT-6.1 Sol for deeper work. Requires Codex access to both models.
templates.compatibility_notes: Follows verified generally available equivalents within the Luna and Sol families. Preserves existing user-created Grunts and menu preferences; never creates effort variants.
